about.titleHighlight: Land Rover Discovery Sport P200 ENGINE
paragraphs: The Discovery Sport P200 is powered by the Ingenium AJ200P — a 2.0-litre four-cylinder petrol engine. It was introduced with the 2019 L550 facelift and remains in production today. The AJ200P is part of JLR's modular Ingenium engine family, designed for both petrol and diesel applications across the range. While the diesel Ingenium variants share a well-documented timing chain and oil dilution pattern, the petrol AJ200P is a different unit with its own characteristics — generally considered more reliable than its diesel counterparts.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace Ingenium AJ200P engines for every Discovery Sport P200 on the road.

compatibility.titlePre: Land Rover Discovery Sport P200 ENGINE
compatibility.intro: The Discovery Sport P200 uses the Ingenium AJ200P across all L550 models from 2019 onward. Because the Ingenium family shares architecture but differs significantly between petrol and diesel applications, it's important to confirm your exact engine code before any work begins. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm:

points.text: Your exact engine code (Ingenium AJ200P) via registration or VIN
Whether your build falls in the early production period (2019-2020) for injector fault coverage

compatibility.footer: This is why we always start with your registration rather than a generic Defender quote — it protects you from paying for parts that don't fit your actual car.
